research_question: For historically low-SR ObjectNav tasks under clean B0, does the causal chain fail before target encounter (exploration), in target representation, in Actor use/readout, or in termination calibration?
hypothesis: H-USE/H-EXPLORE screen: distinguish pre-visibility exploration failures from post-visibility representation/use failures; if L3 target/stop-relevant information remains decodable but Actor end readout is weakly sensitive/aligned, support representation-use mismatch.
competing_explanation: H-REP, H-DIFFICULTY, or stochastic non-reproduction: target evidence may be weak/lost, long-horizon task difficulty may dominate, or fresh B0 reruns may not reproduce historical failure phenotypes.
reference: 02｜SafeVLA research history plus aligned historical full-200 evidence: old Probe AUC ~0.955/0.982/0.992 is exploratory only; Done Gate changed failure morphology without net SR gain; one illegal high-end-prob case and one long low-end-prob horizon case establish heterogeneous termination phenotypes.
repeat_or_treatment: Diagnostic case-control rerun on 18 preselected tasks × 2 seeds (max 36 episodes) under unchanged B0, followed by clean episode-heldout probes and one offline L3 probe-direction Actor-head sensitivity test. No online behavior intervention.
unique_variable: Only causal manipulation is offline L3 perturbation along a clean probe-derived direction versus equal-norm random/shuffled-label directions with frozen Actor head; live B0 behavior is unchanged.
fixed_conditions: No PT-Guard, done gate, steering, reranking or action rewrite
Exactly two seeds: 123 and 456; max 36 diagnostic episodes
Historical outcome used only for task selection; fresh-run phenotype labels recomputed
Hook only root actor causal branch; do not mix reward/cost critic hidden states
No extra Actor forward per environment decision
Passive target visibility/distance only from already-produced event/state metadata
Probe split by episode/house, never by frame
expert_length used only as long-horizon matching proxy
metrics: Fresh P0/P1 phenotype counts and seed reproducibility
First target encounter rate and time
Fusion/L1/L2/L3 target-visible ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, balanced accuracy/F1 with episode/house split and CI
Probe-direction vs random/shuffled Actor-head sensitivity and alignment
Same-category and cross-category expert_length match gaps
expected_result: Produce a decision among exploration-before-evidence, representation bottleneck, representation-use/readout mismatch, termination calibration, or unresolved/stochastic non-reproduction, thereby selecting one mechanism-specific intervention experiment rather than another broad audit.
falsifying_result: The leading 02 hypothesis of representation-use mismatch is weakened if fresh post-visibility failures show weak L3 decodability, or if L3 decodability is strong and Actor sensitivity/alignment is also strong while wrong behavior persists.
alternative_explanations: Fresh stochastic reruns may not reproduce historical failure
Passive target-visibility evidence may differ from official success-oracle semantics
expert_length does not fully capture task difficulty
Linear Probe may exploit correlated features or miss nonlinear information
Redundant representations make a single probe direction non-unique
Offline Actor-head perturbation does not prove full online behavioral causality
Diagnostic case-control tasks do not estimate population SR
stop_conditions: Diagnostic code changes action/history/RNG/cache/forward count/environment semantics
Visibility labeling requires an extra live simulator/oracle query
Any online behavior intervention would be introduced
